title: HHHusher review (v2)
description: One customer review: a row of five small yellow stars, the quote in a large medium-weight grotesk, and the reviewer's name in bold monospaced type (caps or as written). Rises 40px and fades in as it enters the window.
notes: stars use the primary colour; quote and name inherit the text colour of the band
name: hhhusher-v2-review

props.name: size
props.description: lg: the landing page's 24px quotes · md: the product page's 21px quotes

props.name: nameCase
props.description: caps: the name in capitals (landing) · as-written: as typed (product page)

props.name: step
props.description: stagger position when several reveal together
